verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the official, open-source AWS CDK in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C#/.Net and Go. It covers building against AWS in code, but only for defining and provisioning infrastructure through CloudFormation. No evidence mentions the general-purpose AWS service SDKs for calling services from application code. Missing for 10: documentation of official per-language AWS service SDKs, SDK coverage of service APIs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The AWS CDK supports TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, C#/.Net, and Go.
The AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) is an open-source software development framework for defining cloud infrastructure in code and provisioning it through AWS CloudFormation.
You can use the Cost Explorer API to programmatically query your cost and usage data.
